# Frequent questions

**English** · [Español](PREGUNTAS.md)

<!-- Generated by scripts/build_faq.py from frontend/src/locales/en/help.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

The most common questions when using CandidatAI, with the screen where each one is sorted out. They are the same ones the app's help button searches, at the bottom right (it opens with `?`). For the detail, see the [user guide](GUIDE.md); if this is your first time, [Start here](START_HERE.md).

## Getting started

### What does CandidatAI do, and what does my agent do?

CandidatAI organises your job search: it gathers the jobs, scores their fit, keeps your CVs and tracks each process. Reading the jobs and writing CVs and letters is done by your AI agent, which you install on your computer. “How it works” walks through the whole journey.

Where: “How it works”.

### Where do I start?

With your profile: upload your CV and create the profile from it. Then search for jobs or add one you have seen. Home shows your next step at every moment.

Where: “Home”.

### How do I create my profile?

In “My profile”, press “Upload my CV” and then “Create my profile from my CV”. Your agent reads the CV, asks you for what is missing and shows you the result. Afterwards you can adjust each block on the same page.

Where: “My profile”.

### Can I create the profile without an agent?

Yes. In “My profile”, “Start by hand” creates a profile with your name, your headline and the role you are after, and opens the editor to complete the rest.

Where: “My profile”.

### What can I do without an agent?

Add, approve and discard jobs, track your processes, use the calendar and the results, edit your profile and change the design of a CV you already have. Reading jobs and writing CVs, letters and interview guides requires the agent.

Where: “Agent”.

### How do I change the language or the light and dark theme?

With the globe and theme buttons at the bottom of the sidebar. The app remembers your choice in this browser. Your data and what your agent writes follow the language of each job.

## Your agent

### What is “your agent” and which one do I need?

An AI agent is a program you install on your computer, such as Claude Code or Codex, and it uses your subscription. The Claude or ChatGPT chat app is something else: the agent is the separate program that comes with that same subscription. The “Agent” page says whether you have one ready and how to install it.

Where: “Agent”.

### How much does it cost?

CandidatAI is free. The agent costs whatever its plan costs: about US$20 a month with Claude Pro or ChatGPT Plus, and nothing with a free or local model. The “Cost” section of the “Agent” page adds up what each action spends.

Where: “Agent”.

### What happens when I press an agent button?

Your agent opens with the instruction already written. The arrow on the button lets you choose: in a separate window, where you see and approve what it does; in the background, with no window; or leave it for your next session.

Where: “Agent”.

### Where do I see what my agent is doing?

In the notice at the bottom right, which appears on every page with what it has done so far and changes when it finishes. The “Agent” page keeps the detail of each run and its usage.

Where: “Agent”.

### What is “Leave for my next session”?

It saves the request for later. Next time you open your agent, press “Handle requests” on the “Agent” page and it will do them one by one.

Where: “Agent”.

### My agent is asking me something: where do I answer?

In the notice that appears at the bottom right, or in your agent's window. The permissions it asks for and long conversations, such as a mock interview, stay in its window.

### How do I choose which agent or model is used?

On the “Agent” page, “Configure agents” lets you choose the default agent, the model for each one and a different one for a specific action. The arrow on each button changes it for that time only.

Where: “Agent”.

### Can I ask my agent for something from the portal?

Yes. Click “Assistant”, at the bottom right, write what you need and press Enter or the arrow. If your agent runs in the background from the app, the answer appears in the same panel, with links to whatever changed; if not, it is saved as a request for your next session. Each time you open it you start a new conversation; earlier ones stay in “Previous conversations”, and within a conversation your agent remembers what you already asked.

### What can my agent do when I ask from the portal?

Look up your jobs, processes, interviews, profile and results, assess a job that has already been read, and save the instructions for a cover letter. To generate a CV or a letter it points you to its button. Submitting an application, approving, discarding and deleting are always confirmed by you in the app.

## Jobs

### How do I add a job I have seen on a website?

In “New job”, paste its link. If the link fails to open, copy the text of the job and paste it under “Paste text”, with the role and the company.

Where: “New job”.

### How do I get jobs to arrive on their own?

In “Where to search” you choose where they come from: job boards, company career sites, email alerts and the browser button. What arrives appears in the Job inbox.

Where: “Where to search”.

### How do I follow a specific company's jobs?

In “Where to search → Company career sites”, press “Add company” and paste its name and the address of its careers site as you see it. “Test” tells you which system it uses and which jobs fit you; if the address filters by city, that's kept. From then on it's checked every day. If the site isn't recognized, it's added to your job sites and your agent browses it when searching.

Where: “Company career sites”.

### How do I search for jobs on the job boards?

In “Search jobs”, press “Search now”: your agent goes through the job boards you have chosen with your browser and adds what it finds. A notice tells you when it finishes.

Where: “Search jobs”.

### How do I connect my email to receive the alerts?

Create alerts on your job boards and have them arrive under a label in your email. Then, in “Email alerts”, “Add mailbox” guides you through your provider and tests the connection before saving.

Where: “Email alerts”.

### What is the browser button?

An extension for Chrome, Edge or Brave that sends the job you are looking at to CandidatAI, with one click. “Browser button” guides you through installing and connecting it.

Where: “Browser button”.

### How do I know whether a job fits me?

Every job that has been read has a fit from 0 to 100 against your profile; hover over it to see where it comes from. “Assess new jobs” adds your agent's reasoned assessment.

Where: “Quick review”.

### Why does a job show no fit?

The fit needs two things: your profile created and the job read by your agent. The job's page shows which one is missing and has the button to sort it out.

Where: “Job inbox”.

### How do I approve or discard jobs quickly?

In “Quick review”, with the keyboard: J and K to move, A to approve, D to discard and O to open the job. A discard is undone from its notice; an approval, with “Reopen” on the job's page.

Where: “Quick review”.

### Where do I say which jobs I want and which are discarded?

In “Search jobs”. In the strip at the top, your roles, your places (click one to choose what you accept there), work mode and level. In “More settings”, years of experience, your minimum salary, languages, contract type and what you rule out. Your agent never sees your minimum salary.

Where: “More settings for your search”.

### What are the jobs “To complete”?

The ones that arrived from an alert with only the title and the link. Open them on their job board and send them with the browser button to complete them, or discard the ones that don't interest you.

Where: “To complete”.

## CV, letter and application

### How do I get a CV for a job?

Approve the job and open its page: on the “Application” tab, “Generate CV” asks your agent for a tailored CV, written only from the data in your profile and verified afterwards.

Where: “Job inbox”.

### How do I correct a CV that is already generated?

On the job's page, next to the CV: “Ask for changes” so your agent touches only what you say, “Edit text” to change it yourself and “Design” for the template, the photo and the colour. Each change is a new version and you can go back to any of them.

Where: “Job inbox”.

### Can I use the design of my own CV?

Yes. In “CV templates”, upload a CV with the design you like, as Word, PDF or an image, and press “Turn into a template”.

Where: “CV templates”.

### How do I add, change or remove the CV photo?

In “My profile”, under “About you”. Each template crops it to its shape, and it is included or not depending on the country of the job.

Where: “My profile”.

### And the cover letter?

On the job's page, “Write letter”. It follows your general instructions and the ones for that job, and it matches the CV.

Where: “Job inbox”.

### Does the app send applications for me?

Sending is always your decision. “Prepare application” opens the form, fills it in and stops so you can review it; sending requires your confirmation, one application at a time. Messages and emails are drafts that you copy and send yourself.

Where: “Job inbox”.

## Processes and interviews

### How do I record a reply or an interview?

On the job's page, “What happened?”, or by dragging its card on the Board. Interviews and tests create a dated milestone in your calendar.

Where: “Board”.

### How do I prepare for an interview?

On the job's page, “Process” tab, each interview has “Prepare”, which leaves a PDF guide and a day-by-day plan, and “Mock interview”, to rehearse with your agent one question at a time.

Where: “Board”.

### Can I see my interviews in my calendar?

Yes. “Calendar” gathers interviews, tests and deadlines, and each milestone can be exported to your usual calendar.

Where: “Calendar”.

### What is “Replies”?

If you turn it on for a mailbox, the app reads the emails from the companies in your processes, your agent proposes what happened and you accept or ignore it. The app only reads: sending, moving and deleting emails stays in your hands.

Where: “Replies”.

### How do I know which companies to write to again?

Home tells you about the applications that have gone days without a reply. Your agent writes the follow-up draft and you send it.

Where: “Home”.

### What do the Results tell me?

What works for you: which channel gets you more replies, and sooner (referral, company careers site, job boards), how far each application goes, which roles reply and why you discard jobs.

Where: “Results”.

### What are the “Skills to build”?

The skills the jobs you approve ask for that aren't in your profile yet. Mark them as yours, as a synonym of one in your profile or for the training plan your agent prepares.

Where: “Skills to build”.

## Your data

### What data leaves my computer?

Your data is in a folder on your computer and the app keeps it there. What your agent reads, the jobs and your profile without your email, your phone or your minimum salary, goes to the company behind its model, unless you use a local model.

### Where is my data and how do I back it up?

In a folder on your computer; the user guide says which one for your system. To back it up, close CandidatAI and copy that whole folder wherever you like.

### Is it safe to connect my email?

The app opens only the folder or label you choose, and only to read. Use an app password, different from your own, which you can revoke whenever you like; it is stored encrypted in the system keychain and your agent never sees it.

Where: “Email alerts”.

### And LinkedIn?

Its jobs arrive through your email alerts or with the browser button, and applications on LinkedIn are always sent by you. If you paste a job's link into “New job”, the app guides you: open it and click the browser button, or paste its text. Searching LinkedIn is optional: you turn it on in its card in “Where to search”, under your responsibility.

Where: “Where to search”.

### What is “Demo mode”?

A made-up candidate with jobs, CVs and processes to try the app. It lives in its own folder, separate from your data. To go back to yours, close the demo window and open CandidatAI as usual.

## If something fails

### The page says the app is not responding

The CandidatAI window has been closed or it has stopped. Open it again with its shortcut and reload the page.

### A button doesn't open my agent

The button then shows the full instruction, with “Copy” and where to paste it. Check on the “Agent” page that your agent appears as ready.

Where: “Agent”.

### A Word template doesn't generate the CV

Word templates use LibreOffice, which is free, to create the PDF. Install it and generate the CV again, or choose another template under “Design”.

### No new jobs have arrived today

Automatic sources are checked once a day and with CandidatAI open. Open it and, to bring it forward, press “Search now” in “Search jobs”.

Where: “Where to search”.

### Where do I ask for more help?

In the CandidatAI Discussions on GitHub, or by opening an issue there. To show a failure, use the demo data instead of your own.
